"Ted Lasso" Season 4 will premiere next week (watch here). This season centers on a women's team, with the following new player roster and some notable actors who will not be returning.

"Ted Lasso" Season 4 New Additions: The Greyhounds Women's Team

"Elle" magazine published an article today detailing the main new cast of "Ted Lasso" Season 4, marking the first time the complete cast for the new season has been revealed.

Tanya Reynolds is arguably the most eye-catching new face. She plays Alice Chilton, a member of the newly formed Greyhounds women's team coaching staff, working alongside Coach Lasso and Coach Beard. Here is a storyline preview for her character:

The new team's star players include:

  • Abbie Hern as Gemma, whose greatest asset is her ambition
  • Jude Mack as Boots, a goalkeeper renowned for her intelligence
  • Faye Marsay as Lizzie, brimming with fighting spirit
  • Aisling Sharkey as Niamh and Rex Hayes as Siobhan — twin sisters who play as defenders

For more detailed information and photos on the new cast, refer to the feature article in "Elle".

As was the case in the first three seasons, the team will also see a large number of other players join, but this season will focus on the five members mentioned above, similar to the previous approach of spotlighting core players such as Roy, Jamie and Sam.

Not returning as regular cast: AFC Richmond Men's Team Players

"Ted Lasso" Season 4 will feature relatively few of the beloved characters from previous seasons.

For example, AFC Richmond players Jamie Tartt, Dani Rojas and Sam Obisanya will not appear as regular characters in the new season.

Although they may make cameo appearances, the men's team members from Seasons 1 through 3 will essentially be absent from Season 4.

Nick Mohammed (who plays Nate, Lasso's friend turned nemesis) is expected to return in some form, though not necessarily as a regular cast member.

Core characters such as Ted, Rebecca, Keeley, Roy and Beard are all returning full-time. However, this time they will be working with new members rather than familiar faces from previous seasons.

What are your thoughts on the cast changes in "Ted Lasso" Season 4? Feel free to share your opinions in the comments section.
